name: room-kanban
description: RoomKanban — kanban with folder-based room sync

scripts.dist: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:dir: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win --dir --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:publish: node scripts/bump-version.mjs && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.release:publish: node scripts/bump-version.mjs --no-bump && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.cjs
scripts.ci:release: npm run build && electron-builder --win --publish always --config electron-builder.cjs
